author: Zephyr I
title: Wide synergy: 64/128 CNN + ratio=0.4 with ConvLSTM width ∈ {44,48} (double-step + AttnPool)
abstract: Probe whether reducing ConvLSTM width to 44 with a stronger CNN bottleneck (ratio=0.4) preserves update throughput and lifts solve rate for wide (64/128) double-step + AttnPool.
